desc:
Step into the tiny but thrilling world of ants! 🌍 Build your colony, gather resources 🍂, and defend your nest from dangerous predators 🕷. Choose your role:
Ant:
🛠 Worker 
🛡 Soldier 
👑 Queen
And more!

Explore vast environments, from dense forests 🌲 to underground caves ⛏ filled with treasures and dangers. Team up with other players, form alliances 🤝, and battle rival colonies ⚔. Every choice matters in your quest for survival. Can your colony become the strongest in Ants 3? Join the adventure today!

Step into a strange and fascinating world beneath the soil, where the life of insects, bugs, and other tiny creatures thrive. From ants, beetles, and butterflies to spiders, scorpions, and mantises, the undergrowth is alive with wild activity. Build and expand your own ant colony—dig tunnels, hatch eggs, raise larvae, and protect your queen. Work together as a team to survive against threats like wasps, and termites while exploring gardens, sandboxes, and mysterious spiderwebs.
